name: anvil
description: Anvil is a workflow governor over Superpowers: three paths (just do it, spec first, full), lean contract plans, parallel waves with a spec check after each, and one final verification that ticks off what was asked. Bundles afk (unattended mode), mockups, web-audit, ticket-update, and cross-model (two-model research, only when you ask). Requires superpowers@claude-plugins-official.
